text: Under way in the final round.
Tortoise calls for calm in their own half.
Hare slips straight to the turf.
And now the Fable teammates run straight into each other, leaving Tortoise flat on the deck.
Tortoise takes another tumble out by the touchline. Both of these sides did all their preparation before stepping out here today, but it's a clumsy start.
Hare breaks clean through the middle now with nobody in front to stop them.
Fable applying relentless pressure, pinning Gemini right back against their wall.
Tortoise signals to claim it.
Teammates tangle again, Hare falls.
They have collided once more right on the goal mouth. It is absolute chaos between the two Fable forwards.
The corner panel punches the ball sharply back into the mixer.
An absolute disaster for Flash! The ball ricochets off the defender and rolls right into the net for an own goal. AFC Fable lead one-nil!
Tortoise marches purposefully up the middle into shooting range.
Just wide of the target.
Tortoise tucks it away from point-blank range, doubling the advantage. Two-nil to AFC Fable.
Hare shouts that they are chasing down the loose ball.
Tortoise slots home another from close range. Gemini Flash simply cannot keep up with this attack, and it is three-nil to AFC Fable.
A stinging effort whistles just past the upright.
Fable maintain their relentless siege in the Gemini territory.
Tortoise taps it in at the goal line again. That makes it four-nil, turning this match into a proper rout.
Tortoise bursts clean through into empty space on the left.
Another strike slides narrowly off target.
Hare gets on the scoresheet now, bundling the ball over from right in front. Five-nil to AFC Fable.
Hare calls out to take charge of the advancing ball.
Shaved the outer post.
Hare pounces immediately to turn it in. A six-nil lead for Fable before we have even reached the interval.
Tortoise takes time, nudging the ball steadily into the final third.
The corner panel thumps it back out towards the wing.
Tortoise finds the net once more from close range. It is seven-nil now as Fable run riot.
Hare goes clear on goal.
Hare charges to the mouth.
Hare makes no mistake and tucks it away. Eight-nil to AFC Fable.
Hare calls for support forward.
That whistle brings a breathless first half to a close. AFC Fable lead Gemini Flash FC eight-nil in total command.
A quiet moment in midfield as Spark looks for an answer. Fable arrived here with their routine firmly locked in, and it has paid off in spades so far.
The corner panel fires the ball back into the defensive zone.
Hare pulls the trigger from two metres, flashing just wide.
Hare finds the target yet again. That pushes the scoreline to nine-nil in AFC Fable's favour.
Tortoise calls out, tracking back to cover the defensive line.
Inches away from double figures.
Hare brings up the tenth goal of the match, finishing neatly on the left channel. AFC Fable ten, Gemini Flash nil.
Tortoise pokes in number eleven from right on the line.
Fable maintain their grip, camping right in the Gemini third without letting up.
Hare breaks clean through once again.
Fired wide from the left channel.
Spark loses footing and drops to the turf. A difficult afternoon for Gemini Flash, who have struggled to mount any sustained response.
Tortoise signals to hold position.
A dangerous effort skims just past the target.
Gemini are penned in against their back wall as Fable keep pressing.
Hare bundles another one into the back of the net. That makes it twelve-nil to AFC Fable.
Hare drives down the right.
Just missing the far post.
Tortoise taps home another from two metres out. AFC Fable now lead thirteen-nil with under two minutes remaining.
Hare finds daylight through the midfield with clear grass ahead.
Tortoise shouts to drop back and cover.
Hare patiently works the ball straight through the middle into the final third in the closing minute.
Hare converts in the dying seconds, making it fourteen-nil to AFC Fable.
Full time, AFC Fable finish fourteen-nil winners in an utterly dominant display.
